lyrics:
[verse]
Bruno heard break a leg tonight,
He gasped, oh no, that can't be right!
Kiki smiled, oh Bruno, nay,
It's good luck for your show today!
[chorus]
Break a leg, break a leg,
Take the stage and knock 'em dead!
Break a leg, break a leg,
Dance and sing, go break a leg!
[verse]
On the stage in days of old,
You'd bow so low, so brave and bold,
They'd say good luck in a clever way,
So shine out bright and steal the day!
[chorus]
Break a leg, break a leg,
Take the stage and knock 'em dead!
Break a leg, break a leg,
You're a star, go break a leg!
[outro]
So before the curtains rise,
Go and win that shiny prize!
